reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the segregation-induced elastic stress mechanism from the FeCoCrNiMoAl system (P2, P6, P23) with the shear-driven BCC→FCC transformation mechanism from Al0.7CoCrFeNi (P3, P4) and applies this combined mechanism to a new alloy, Cr39Co18Fe18Ni18Al7, which none of the passages studied. It proposes a specific kinetic competition between segregation-driven strain and shear transformation that is not stated in any single passage.
